# Legacy Modernization
Document as-is capabilities, technical dependencies, interface mapping, data reconciliation, operational readiness, coexistence, strangler increments and decommissioning. Assess effort ranges using explicit assumptions. Include test strategy, cutover gates and rollback.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
